basic_info.description: Discover the charm of Duboce Triangle with this exquisite one-bedroom unit, nestled in a beautiful Edwardian building on one of San Francisco's most desirable, tree-lined streets. This TIC unit, positioned at the back of the building, offers tranquil views of the trees and a charming backyard, providing a serene oasis in the city.  The unit features hardwood floors, high ceilings, and stunning period details, brand new washer/dryer, complemented by custom finishes and a spacious kitchen. The historic building boasts a majestic sky-lit staircase and pristine original oak millwork, adding to its timeless elegance. Unit also comes with a large storage unit.  Enjoy the convenience of nearby amenities, including Whole Foods, Safeway, Muni, BART, and the vibrant Duboce Park. A variety of restaurants, coffee shops, and the Wednesday Farmers Market are just a short stroll away, making this an ideal location for urban living.
